takesSectionVOList.title: Advancing Mental Health
takesSectionVOList.content:
2.20 pm

Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar): Sir, I beg to move, "That this House recognises the importance of mental health as a health, social and economic issue."

In our journey towards a healthier, more resilient Singapore, we must recognise mental health not just as a component of our healthcare system but as a cornerstone of societal well-being.

The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng): Mr Speaker, Sir, the Government shares the sentiments expressed by the Member.

Mr Speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim.

takesSectionVOList.title: Protection for Employees from Unfair Retrenchment Practices
takesSectionVOList.content:
Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang asked the Minister for Manpower whether the Ministry will consider mandating retrenchment benefits.

The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng): Mr Speaker, Sir, the Ministry conducted 4,200 inspections in the preceding year.

takesSectionVOList.title: Personal Data Protection (Amendment) Bill
takesSectionVOList.subTitle: Second Reading
takesSectionVOList.content:
Mrs Josephine Teo (Minister for Communications and Information): Mr Speaker, Sir, I beg to move, "That the Bill be now read a Second time."

The amendments before the House strengthen the Protection Obligation and introduce mandatory breach notification. Organisations will be required to notify the Commission of a notifiable data breach as soon as is practicable.

Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah GRC): Sir, may I ask the Minister to clarify the threshold at which a breach becomes notifiable?
